EAU muscle-invasive and metastatic bladder, 2026. Parsed and never loaded, like its NMIBC companion.

This one carries the material dossier 2 turns on: chapters 6.2 to 6.4 are health status, comorbidity, frailty and geriatric assessment before cystectomy, for exactly the 85-year-old the corpus could not previously answer for.

default.note: The document's centre of gravity is muscle-invasive disease that has not spread: staging it, assessing fitness for cystectomy, and delivering the treatment. Metastatic disease has its own chapter and its own rule; everything else defaults here rather than to `not_specified`, because a passage about cystectomy technique is genuinely about non-metastatic MIBC.

rules.note: Recurrence at distance is metastatic disease. MUST precede nothing in particular, but it sits inside chapter 8, which otherwise defaults to non-metastatic -- so it needs its own rule to escape it.
First-line and later-line systemic therapy, oligometastatic disease, bone metastases. This is the chapter a patient with M1 disease needs, and the one AFU covers in a single short section.

rules.match_section: 10. QUALITY OF LIFE AND PALLIATIVE CARE
rules.note: Quality of life is reported for neoadjuvant therapy, cystectomy, trimodality therapy and metastatic disease alike, and supportive care applies throughout. `spans_settings` rather than the default, so it is admitted for a metastatic question as well as a non-metastatic one.
